verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes an official MCP server (support.ramp.com/ramp-mcp) plus llms.txt/CLI docs, which directly enables AI agents/assistants to operate Ramp via natural-language commands, and it also ships internal AI agents for coding/approval/payment automation. missing for 10: hands-on/independent evidence of a user actually issuing natural-language commands through the MCP server, and detail on what actions/scopes the MCP server exposes.
